findings.detail: The source schedule legitimately presents small negative amortized cost and fair value amounts in parentheses; the extracted negative costs match those source cells.

rationale: The flag is aggregate-level, so I checked schedule anchors first: the filing's SOI total investments line reports amortized cost 1,291,512 and fair value 1,311,001 in thousands. Representative normalized negative-cost rows are not extraction errors: AI Titan Parent rows in the raw SOI show principal as a dash and amortized cost/fair value as parenthesized amounts, e.g. ( 3 ), which correctly normalizes to -3000. The raw source therefore supports the extracted values, and the rule appears to be flagging legitimate parenthetical cost formatting rather than a data defect.
